steps.title: Prepare the site
steps.text: Clear and level the area where the ramp will sit. Mark the footprint of both runs and the turn landing on the ground.
steps.safety_tip: Call before you dig to locate buried utilities.

steps.title: Cut the stringers
steps.text: Cut all stringers for both runs. Each has a level cut where it meets the ground and a plumb cut at the top.

cut_callouts.label: B
cut_callouts.spoken: two-by-six, ninety and three quarters inches

cut_callouts.label: G
cut_callouts.spoken: two-by-six, seventy-eight and a quarter inches

steps.safety_tip: Wear eye and ear protection when using the saw.

steps.title: Cut the ledger and landing framing
steps.text: Cut the ledger and the landing frame: end rims, side rims and inner joists.

steps.title: Build the landing
steps.text: Assemble the landing frame with the inner joists 16 inches apart, then fasten the landing deck boards across it.

steps.title: Attach the ledger
steps.text: Fasten the ledger to the porch at the top of the second run. Check that it is level before you drive the last fasteners.
steps.safety_tip: Make sure the ladder is on firm ground.

steps.title: Set the stringers
steps.text: Set the stringers of both runs, spaced 16 inches on center. Fasten the tops to the landing frame and the ledger.

steps.title: Check the slope
steps.text: Lay a level along each run and confirm the slope is 1 in 12 or gentler before decking.

steps.title: Install the decking
steps.text: Fasten deck boards across the stringers with a small gap between boards. Rip the last board on each run to fit.

steps.title: Install the edge curbs
steps.text: Fasten a curb along both outside edges of each run so wheels and walker feet can't slip off.

cut_callouts.label: C
cut_callouts.spoken: two-by-six, ninety and five sixteenths inches

steps.title: Install the handrail posts and rails
steps.text: Set the 4x4 posts no more than 6 feet apart, then fasten a rail across the top of each row of posts.

cut_callouts.label: A
cut_callouts.spoken: two-by-four, eighty-six and thirteen sixteenths inches

cut_callouts.label: L
cut_callouts.spoken: four-by-four, forty-two and five eighths inches

cut_callouts.label: M
cut_callouts.spoken: four-by-four, thirty-nine and seven eighths inches

cut_callouts.label: N
cut_callouts.spoken: four-by-four, thirty-six and a quarter inches

steps.safety_tip: Rails must be solid enough to lean on. Test them before use.

steps.title: Final check
steps.text: Check every fastener, sand splinters, and walk the whole ramp slowly before anyone relies on it.
